userdoc.notice: Same check as the official AnonAadhaar contract, but accepts several UIDAI signing keys. UIDAI rotates the key that signs Aadhaar Secure QRs (2021 key, Feb-2026 key, current 2026 key valid to 2029). The official contract stores ONE key hash, so it would reject every QR signed with any other key. Here the accepted key hashes are fixed at deployment: there is no admin and no way to add keys later, so nobody can quietly accept a forged "UIDAI" key.
